incumbent.description: Triggers when the user invokes `/gtm-workspace` or asks to create, import, update, delete, validate, or repair a GTM workspace repo or folder, including adding teammates or suborganizations. Not for defining ICPs or personas, or for tasks that merely use an existing workspace without changing or validating it.

selection.reason: All measured descriptions tied at 100% held-out accuracy; the incumbent retained the highest overall accuracy and negative specificity, so replacing it would be a regression.
